title: PLASMA: A Layout-Aware Benchmark Reveals Memory Layout Matters for Graph-based ANNS on GPU
abstract: arXiv:2508.15436v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a $\textbf{P}$latform for $\textbf{L}$ayout-$\textbf{A}$ware $\textbf{S}$earch and $\textbf{M}$emory $\textbf{A}$rrangement ($\textbf{PLASMA}$), a unified evaluation framework for graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) on GPU that isolates the effects of graph index topology and memory layout. Graph-based ANNS is essential in modern AI applications such as RAG, and GPU utilization is attracting attention for datasets of millions or more vectors. Our framework extracts the topology of arbitrary graph-based indices and enables execution under a unified, GPU-optimized search algorithm, specifying the correspondence between vertex IDs and positions on memory to allow arbitrary vertex orderings. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that vertex reordering yields up to $80\%$ (typically $10-30\%$) QPS improvement while preserving search accuracy.

translated_title: PLASMA：一个布局感知基准揭示内存布局对GPU上基于图的近似最近邻搜索至关重要
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个用于GPU上基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）的统一评估框架——布局感知搜索与内存排列平台（PLASMA），该框架能够隔离图索引拓扑和内存布局的影响。基于图的ANNS在现代AI应用（如RAG）中至关重要，而GPU利用对于包含数百万或更多向量的数据集正受到关注。我们的框架提取任意基于图的索引的拓扑结构，并在统一的、GPU优化的搜索算法下执行，通过指定顶点ID与内存位置之间的对应关系，允许任意的顶点排序。通过全面实验，我们证明顶点重排序在保持搜索精度的同时，能带来高达80%（通常为10-30%）的每秒查询数（QPS）提升。
tldr: 本文提出了PLASMA，一个统一评估框架，首次系统性地揭示了在GPU上基于图的ANNS中，内存布局（顶点重排序）可带来高达80%的性能提升，而这一因素此前常被忽视。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PLASMA, a unified evaluation framework that systematically reveals memory layout (vertex reordering) can yield up to 80% QPS improvement for graph-based ANNS on GPU, a factor previously overlooked.
